International Bus Mach (IBM) Shareholder Stillwater Investment Management Has Trimmed Its Position; Barton Investment Management Lowered Position in Qualcomm (QCOM) as Market Value Declined
April 27, 2018 - By John Mackenzie
Stillwater Investment Management Llc decreased its stake in International Bus Mach (IBM) by 33.78% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Stillwater Investment Management Llc sold 3,946 shares as the company’s stock declined 0.39% with the market. The institutional investor held 7,736 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $1.19 million, down from 11,682 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Stillwater Investment Management Llc who had been investing in International Bus Mach for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $135.15 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.53% or $0.78 during the last trading session, reaching $146.72. About 4.27M shares traded. International Business Machines Corporation (NYSE:IBM) has declined 12.58% since April 27, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 24.13% the S&P500.
